hook: A strengthening 2026 El Niño brings severe below-normal rainfall from Palau to the Marshall Islands.

sections.voiceover: A strengthening 2026 El Niño brings severe below-normal rainfall from Palau to the Marshall Islands.
sections.visual_cue: Satellite map showing Pacific Ocean temperature anomalies and dry regions.

sections.voiceover: In November 2026, the World Meteorological Organization reported below-normal rainfall from Palau to the Marshall Islands. How many are critical?
sections.visual_cue: Animated map highlighting the Pacific island chain from Palau to Fiji.

sections.voiceover: Worse, the Pacific Islands Climate and Ocean Forum warns that 2026's El Niño exceeds records set since 1950.
sections.visual_cue: Historical climate trend graph showing 1950 as the baseline.

sections.voiceover: This leaves 24,600 people relying on intermittent supplies or emergency water carting.
sections.visual_cue: Infographic showing 19 of 44 water sources highlighted in red.

sections.voiceover: About 24,600 people in Fiji now rely on water carting as this El Niño deepens.
sections.visual_cue: Aerial shot of a rural Fijian community landscape during drought.
